entries.note:
Make Mask for Italic:
- Select all
- Decompose
- Select MonospacedGlyphs (class)
- Macro: invert selection
- Slant 11 degrees to the right, both masters
- Horizontal Scale 98%, both masters
- Select MonospacedGlyphs (class)
- Slant 10.78065 degrees to the right, both masters
- Select all
- Light master: Move H -54
- Black master: Move H -45
- Macro: Make MM character box
- exchange a and a.alt1
- exchange g and g.alt1
